name: Proper Stable Labeled Sample Compression / Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: The stable-compression lower bound applies directly; properness and labeled reconstruction are additional restrictions. On the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $n\ge2$, the database-owned value proofs give $\lceil(n-1)/2\rceil\le\mathrm{psLSC}(\mathcal S_n)\le n-1$, while $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal S_n)=1$ (values 1157 and 1062). Therefore no universal reverse affine bound is possible. Only linear asymptotic order, not an exact psLSC formula, is used.
proof_source: Full proof in the LaTeX survey: Theorem thm:stable-comp-low-NCTD-star.
witness_review: The former full-cube strict witness remains withdrawn because both endpoint values are $\lceil n/2\rceil$. It is replaced by the independently supported unbounded singleton witness; the cube equality is not changed.
